description: All chart and live-stream UI work. Depends on FEAT-001 (wsClient.ts must exist, appStore must export liveEvents/wsConnected). steps: Run `cd "/Users/macbookpro/Desktop/work/codesential ai/apps/desktop" && npm install recharts@2.13.3` — this pins the exact version as required by AGENTS.md. Confirm package.json shows `"recharts": "2.13.3"` (no ^ or ~).

Rewrite /Users/macbookpro/Desktop/work/codesential ai/apps/desktop/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx. Keep all existing imports and add recharts: `import { PieChart, Pie, Cell, BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts';`. Keep existing severity/open counts. Add: `const mediumCount = findings.filter(f => f.severity === 'medium').length; const lowInfoCount = findings.filter(f => f.severity === 'low' || f.severity === 'informational').length; const severityData = [{name:'Critical',value:criticalCount,color:'#ef4444'},{name:'High',value:highCount,color:'#f59e0b'},{name:'Medium',value:mediumCount,color:'#eab308'},{name:'Low/Info',value:lowInfoCount,color:'#6366f1'}]; const barData = [...scans].slice(0,10).reverse().map(s => ({date: new Date(s.started_at).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric'}), findings: s.findings_count}));`. Change layout: Row 1 is `grid grid-cols-5 gap-4` with the 4 stat cards in `col-span-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4` and the donut PieChart (innerRadius=40, outerRadius=65, 140×140px) in col-span-1. Row 2 is full-width bar chart panel with ResponsiveContainer height=160, linearGradient id=barGradient (#6366f1 0.9→0.4), dark tooltip, empty-state message if barData is empty. Row 3 is unchanged `grid grid-cols-3 gap-6` with scanner matrix (col-span-2) and agent actions (col-span-1).

Rewrite /Users/macbookpro/Desktop/work/codesential ai/apps/desktop/src/pages/LiveMonitoring.tsx. Add `useState, useEffect` to React import. Pull `liveEvents, wsConnected` from `useAppStore()` (alongside existing activeProject, scans). Remove the hardcoded `recentEvents` array. Add `const [now, setNow] = useState(Date.now())` with a 10s interval effect. Add `relTime(ts?: string)` helper: <60s→'just now', <3600s→'Xm ago', else toLocaleTimeString(). Add `dotColor(type: string)` helper mapping event types to bg-* class names. Replace the stream-status badge to show green+animate-ping if wsConnected else amber+animate-pulse+'Connecting...'. Replace the events list: if liveEvents.length===0 show animated pulse dot + 'Waiting for filesystem events…' centered; else render liveEvents.slice(0,50) with the color dot, label (evt.data?.file as string || evt.message || evt.type), and relTime timestamp.

Rewrite the ablation study section of /Users/macbookpro/Desktop/work/codesential ai/apps/desktop/src/pages/ModelInsights.tsx. Add recharts imports: `import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Legend } from 'recharts';`. Build chartData array mapping ['Accuracy','Precision','Recall','F1','Specificity'] to {metric, 'Baseline A': number, 'Baseline B': number, 'Baseline C': number} where values are 0-100 (multiply by 100, round). Insert a `<div style={{width:200,height:200}}>` containing a PieChart 200×200 with Pie cx=95 cy=95 innerRadius=50 outerRadius=80, between the export-buttons header and the grid-cols-3 compliance section.

Run `cd "/Users/macbookpro/Desktop/work/codesential ai/apps/desktop" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1` and fix every TypeScript error. findings: All steps implemented and verified. (1) recharts@2.13.3 installed with exact pin (no ^ or ~) in package.json. (2) Dashboard.tsx rewritten with 5-col Row 1 (4 stat cards + severity donut PieChart), full-width Row 2 scan history BarChart with linearGradient, and unchanged Row 3 scanner/agent grid. (3) LiveMonitoring.tsx rewritten to consume liveEvents/wsConnected from appStore — removed hardcoded recentEvents array, added wsConnected status badge, dotColor/relTime helpers, and live event list rendering. (4) ModelInsights.tsx ablation table replaced with recharts grouped BarChart (Baseline A/B/C) with fallback values; inference playground unchanged. (5) Reports.tsx now imports PieChart/Pie/Cell/Tooltip from recharts, computes severityData, and renders a 200x200 mini donut above the compliance grid. (6) index.css appended with .recharts-cartesian-axis-tick-value and .recharts-tooltip-wrapper overrides. (7) npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 with zero error lines.
